The '''''Asis''''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The transport was to rendezvous with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] at [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] but was [[Ambush at Sul-34|destroyed]] at [[Sul-34]] by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in a [[Missile Boat]].
